rows.definition: dispatchtick.CandidateBlockedBy parses a dispatch candidate's blocked-by grammar - which other candidates a candidate must wait on before it becomes eligible for a lane.
rows.distinction: A DISPATCH-candidate prereq-ordering field (who blocks whom in the ready-set), not the ctxplanner Candidate (a scored context span). It orders launch eligibility; it never scores a span for a resident view.

rows.definition: cmd/fak/knownbad.go buildKnownBadIssuePlan builds the create/update PLAN for filing a known-bad record as a deduped GitHub issue (title, body, occurrence escalation).
rows.distinction: A dogfood-ISSUE create/update plan (a side-effect plan for gh), distinct from the ctxplanner Plan (a resident context view) and the memq Plan (a static execution explain). It plans an issue write, not a context view or a run.

rows.definition: candidateIDs (internal/kvmmu/rescore.go, internal/modelroute/audit_route.go) is the parallel vector of identifiers for the items being scored - KV spans under rescore, or routes under audit - whose results line up index-for-index.
rows.distinction: A vector of candidate IDENTIFIERS carried alongside a score array (rescore/route audit), distinct from the ctxplanner Candidate (the scored span itself) and from a bounded candidate SET size (CandidateBound). Ids-parallel-to-scores, not the candidate object or its cap.

rows.definition: CandidatesExamined (cmd/fak/issue_repair.go, internal/issuecontractrepair) is the count of repair candidates the issue-contract repair loop inspected in a run, reported in its manifest.
rows.distinction: A COUNT of examined repair candidates (a loop-progress metric), distinct from the ctxplanner Candidate (a scored span) and from candidate-count (a dispatch PRICE). It tallies work done, not a span or a cost.

rows.definition: candidatesPath (cmd/fak/dispatch_progress.go, cmd/fak/ideascout.go) is the filesystem PATH to the dispatch ready-set candidates file that the progress fold reads and ages.
rows.distinction: A FILE PATH to the dispatch candidate ready-set on disk, distinct from the ctxplanner Candidate (an in-memory scored span) and from the lane-ordering of candidates. A path string, not the candidate object or its order.

rows.definition: decodeCandidates (cmd/fak/dispatch_aging.go, dispatch_progress.go) decodes the raw dispatch ready-set JSON into candidate records for the aging/progress fold.
rows.distinction: A DISPATCH-candidate decoder, distinct from parseCandidates and decodeIssueContractCandidates - each decodes a DIFFERENT candidate corpus (dispatch ready-set vs issue-contract vs generic). Same verb, different domain payload.

rows.definition: FAK_ABLATE_BP_PLAN (internal/ablate/ablate.go) is the env var bound to FeatureBreakpointPlan (bp_plan) - the ablation knob that disables the PlaceAnthropicCacheBreakpoint pre-flight breakpoint plan.
rows.distinction: The ENV-VAR spelling of the bp_plan ablation feature, distinct from FeatureBreakpointPlan (its sweep-token constant) and from BreakpointPlan (the promptmmu cache-breakpoint layout it ablates). Knob-name vs sweep-token vs the plan itself.

rows.definition: guardrsi.KnownBadCandidate (internal/guardrsi/fleetcorrelate.go) is a candidate known-bad pattern surfaced by fleet correlation - a recurring failure signature proposed for a known-bad issue.
rows.distinction: A KNOWN-BAD promotion candidate (a failure pattern proposed for filing), distinct from the ctxplanner Candidate (a scored context span) and from SkillCandidate (a proposed-skill promotion record). A bad-pattern candidate, not a span or a skill.

rows.definition: nCandidate (internal/signals/select.go) is the count of candidates considered in a signal-selection pass.
rows.distinction: A COUNT of candidates in signal selection (a local tally), distinct from candidate-count (a dispatch PRICE unit) and from CandidateBound (the ctxplan index-bounded set cap). Local count vs price vs cap.

rows.definition: plannedOpen (internal/checkpointscore/checkpointscore.go) reports whether a PLANNED subsystem is still an open gap - its declared directory is absent, so the plan has not yet been built.
rows.distinction: A predicate over a PLANNED-but-unbuilt subsystem (does its dir exist yet), distinct from planless (a trajctl unscheduled-objective reading) and ClosedNotPlanned (a closureaudit bucket). Planned-and-open vs unplanned vs closed-unplanned.

rows.definition: planProfile (cmd/fak/multisubmit.go, cmd/fak/profile.go) is the PURE planning step of multisubmit - it computes the submission plan from inputs, split out from the impure runProfile that executes it.
rows.distinction: The pure PLAN-construction half of multisubmit (split from the impure runProfile), distinct from the ctxplanner Plan (a resident view) and PlanReport (a nightrun report). A pure/impure code split, not a context view or a report.

rows.definition: PrefixCandidates (internal/resume/rehome/resolve.go, resolve_prefix.go) is the set of session-id prefixes a partial id could match, carried with PrefixResolvedFrom for the #3782 partial-id disambiguation.
rows.distinction: The candidate SESSION-ID PREFIXES for resolving a partial id, distinct from the ctxplanner Candidate (a scored span) and from PlanResume (the preflight pre-resume advisory rung). Id-resolution candidates, not spans or a resume rung.
